facts.statement: Gideonmantellia lived during the Early Cretaceous Barremian stage in what is now Spain.
facts.quote: Gideonmantellia is an extinct genus of basal ornithopod dinosaur known from the Early Cretaceous (Barremian stage) Camarillas Formation of Galve, Province of Teruel, Spain.

facts.statement: Amateur paleontologist José María Herrero Marzo and his son discovered the remains of Gideonmantellia in 1982 near Galve, Spain.
facts.quote: In 1982, amateur palaeontologist José María Herrero Marzo together with his son Jesús uncovered in a loam pit near Galve, the Poyales Barranco Canales site, the remains of a small euornithopod.

facts.statement: The species Gideonmantellia amosanjuanae was validly named in 2012 by a team led by Ruiz-Omeñaca.
facts.quote: In 2012, the type species Gideonmantellia amosanjuanae was validly named and redescribed by Ruiz-Omeñaca, José Ignacio Canudo, Gloria Cuenca-Bescós, Penélope Cruzado-Caballero, José Manuel Gasca and Miguel Moreno-Azanza.

facts.statement: The genus name Gideonmantellia honors Gideon Mantell, the first describer of Hypsilophodon.
facts.quote: The generic name honours the first describer of Hypsilophodon, Gideon Mantell.

facts.statement: The species name amosanjuanae honors the paleontologist Olga María Amo Sanjuán.
facts.quote: The specific name honours the late palaeontologist Olga María Amo Sanjuán, who studied the Cretaceous Galve fauna.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Gideonmantellia represents a small animal less than one meter long.
facts.quote: El holotipo de Gideonmantellia se refiere a un animal pequeño, de menos de un metro de largo.

facts.statement: Researchers estimate the adult Gideonmantellia reached a length of about 2 meters and weighed 20 kilograms.
facts.quote: Los descriptores estiman la longitud del animal adulto alrededor de 2 metros, el peso en 20 kilogramos.

facts.statement: The toe formula of Gideonmantellia is 2-3-4-5-0.
facts.quote: La fórmula de las falanges de los pies es 2-3-4-5-0.

facts.statement: The perone bone of Gideonmantellia does not touch the calcaneus at the bottom.
facts.quote: El peroné en la parte inferior del calcáneo no se toca.

facts.statement: Gideonmantellia is classified as a basal member of the group Ornithopoda.
facts.quote: Today this is considered an unnatural paraphyletic group and Gideonmantellia was in 2012 placed in a relatively basal position in the group Ornithopoda.

facts.statement: A 2017 study by Madzia et al. identified Gideonmantellia as the most basal ornithopod.
facts.quote: Más recientemente, un estudio de 2017 de Madzia et al. que describe el género Burianosaurus encontró Gideonmantellia para ser el ornitópodo más basal.

facts.statement: Gideonmantellia possessed a prepubic process shaped like a rod with a widened and rotated front end.
facts.quote: El proceso de prepubicus tiene forma de varilla con un extremo delantero ensanchado y girado.

facts.statement: The first chevron of Gideonmantellia's tail forms a right angle between its top and bottom parts, unlike the gradual curve or straight shape seen in other ornithopods.
facts.quote: En el primer cheurón de la cola, la parte inferior forma un ángulo recto con la parte superior, mientras que en otros ornitópodos la conexión forma una curva gradual o el primer cheurón es recto.

facts.statement: The prepubic process of Gideonmantellia rotates strongly around its longitudinal axis, with the side turned 52 degrees upward.
facts.quote: El largo proceso de prepubicus, que se ensancha considerablemente en la parte delantera, gira fuertemente alrededor del eje longitudinal, con el lado girado 52° hacia arriba.

facts.statement: In Gideonmantellia, the sacral vertebrae were not yet fused into a sacrum.
facts.quote: Las vértebras sacras aún no estaban fusionadas en un sacro.

facts.statement: Gideonmantellia had a short ascending process on its jumping leg that extended past the front of the tibia.
facts.quote: La pierna que salta tiene solo una rama corta ascendente, el proceso ascendente, que sobrepasa el frente inferior de la tibia.

facts.statement: Between 1995 and 2001, Gideonmantellia was assigned to the family Hypsilophodontidae.
facts.quote: Este taxón fue asignado entre 1995 a 2001 a la familia Hypsilophodontidae.

facts.statement: Gideonmantellia belongs to the family Hypsilophodontidae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Hypsilophodontidae

facts.statement: Gideonmantellia is classified within the dinosaur class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: Gideonmantellia lived during the Barremian stage, between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Barremian (125.77 to 121.4 million years ago)

facts.statement: The genus Gideonmantellia was named by Ruiz-Omeñaca and colleagues in 2012.
facts.quote: Ruiz-Omeñaca et al. 2012

facts.statement: Only one fossil occurrence of Gideonmantellia has been recorded.
facts.quote: Fossil occurrences recorded: 1
